changelog.olderNotice: Versions before v1.8.0 are listed in English.

items: Promptea now speaks Brazilian Portuguese: pick PT in the header. The interface, the product pages, the glossary, the model pages and the prompt packs are translated.
The analyzer answers in Portuguese: score, findings, recommendations and the optimized prompt. A prompt written in Portuguese is analyzed properly from any language of the site.
Find the best AI explains its recommendation in Portuguese too.
AI Daily and the newsletter are still written in English and Spanish: under PT they are shown in English, and the page says so.
The 58 prompting guides are translated into Portuguese too.
Image prompts requested in Portuguese are composed in English around your own words, which is what image generators understand best.

A new home page that explains itself at a glance: what Promptea does, the two things you can do (analyze a prompt, find the best AI) and the box to paste your prompt, which now says what you get back.
One menu for the whole site, in the same place on every page, with a compact version on phones.
New page “How Promptea works”: how a prompt is scored, which AIs are supported, the FAQ and the product tour.
Benchmarks: the ranking no longer overlaps on any screen, phones no longer scroll sideways, and a new chart shows which providers are in the top of each benchmark.
The prompt you paste on the home page no longer travels in the address bar on its way to the analyzer.
The newsletter card opens by itself only on your first visit, without blocking the page; after that it stays as a small pill.
The background moves a little more; if your system asks for reduced motion it stays still.
Fixes: the analyzer works with browser storage blocked, weekly editions show their real label, and the footer shows the right version.
Prompt engine: a before → after score for the optimized prompt, better handling of every prompt type, and an optional second AI provider so the optimizer keeps working when one is down.
Benchmarks with charts: top models per benchmark, price vs. score, a frontier matrix and a cost calculator.
A prompt library saved only in your browser, and a shareable card with your score (never the prompt text).
Brand: the mascot is now the favicon and the social card, and it hops when you hover or tap it. The feedback dialog no longer shows the page through it.
About and Methodology pages, a larger glossary and deeper guides.
Easier to find and cite: structured data on every page, llms.txt and a plain-text version of each guide for AI assistants.
